metadata.name: Aihara Map
metadata.author: Aihara, K.; Takabe, T.; Toyoda, M.
metadata.description: Aihara reduced one-state chaotic neuron with logistic graded output

dynamics.y: k * y - alpha * sigmoid(y / epsilon) + bias + I

extensions.source_equation_note: Aihara (1989), RIMS Kokyuroku 710, Eqs. 8-12; the manuscript cites the 1990 Aihara-Takabe-Toyoda article as submitted.
extensions.input_note: I is the effective additive stimulus a(t); raw A(t) requires the Eq. 5 temporal transform.
extensions.defaults_note: y0=0.1 is the Figure 5 initial condition; k=0.7, bias=0.3968, epsilon=0.01 and alpha=1 are the Figure 4 chaotic operating point.
